PLAN 03 | SHOTS 06-08 | THE ROOM IS BREACHED
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 3 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_MUSICIAN = {{CHAR_MUSICIAN}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_INSTRUMENT = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT}}
PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_BREACH. Start with the same closed door, sisters seated, cat beside Shahrnaz and musician playing visually. A enters first, B second, C third. Exactly six adults and one cat occupy the room after entry. The intact and broken instrument references are two states of ONE object.

SHOT 06 | 00:00-00:04 | THE DOOR GIVES
28mm from inside the room, shoulder-height facing the entrance. A forces the door inward and enters with B and C. The camera recoils half a step. At frame-left Shahrnaz lifts the cat with both hands; at frame-right Arnavaz rises toward B. Keep their positions legible.
SHOT 07 | 00:04-00:09 | THE MUSICIAN DISPLACED
Cut to a 35mm oblique medium shot beside the musician. C shoves the musician’s shoulder against the wall and takes the instrument. The musician slides into a seated position and reaches after it. A and B continue toward the sisters in the background.
SHOT 08 | 00:09-00:15 | ONE BREAK
Cut to 50mm at instrument height. C drives its neck-to-body joint once against the existing stone doorway edge, producing the referenced fracture. Hold the single instrument body and attached loose strings clearly through the impact. C lets it fall beside the seated musician. End on the musician’s hand stopping short of the broken wood.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
The same warm room light continues. Opening the existing doorway admits a narrow colder corridor spill. Handheld exposure stays natural as bodies interrupt the light.
SOUND
Door impact, hurried boots, a chair scrape, one sharp wooden fracture, loose-string rattle, startled breath. The instrument produces mechanical contact rather than melody.
END STATE AND EDIT
Shahrnaz stands holding the cat against her chest. Arnavaz stands between her and B. A is beside Shahrnaz; C stands by the broken instrument. The musician remains alive, seated against the wall.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Preserve every referenced identity, sculptural mask, costume, body proportion, animal design and architectural feature. Express emotion through breathing, hands, shoulders, balance and movement.

START STATE AND SPATIAL BLOCKING:

Shahrnaz sits frame-left with the cat beside her, both hands already cupped around it. Arnavaz sits to her right, turned toward the closed doorway in the right background. The musician sits deeper left with the intact instrument.

Outside the door, Guard A has his right palm planted against it. Guard B waits behind him; Guard C follows.

A moves toward Shahrnaz, B confronts Arnavaz, and C moves toward the musician. Preserve these assignments.

SHOT 06 | 00:00–00:04 | THE DOOR EXPLODES INWARD

24mm shoulder-height handheld camera inside the room, close enough to include the sisters in the foreground and the doorway behind them.

A drives the door open with his body. B and C surge in behind him.

The camera operator recoils one abrupt step, producing a sharp vertical jolt and momentary motion blur, then catches the sisters again.

Shahrnaz flinches hard. The cat flattens its ears, crouches and gathers its hind legs to spring away. Her waiting hands scoop it up before it jumps; one forearm supports its hindquarters as she draws it against her chest.

Beside her, Arnavaz springs to her feet and steps into B’s path. Her weight moves forward while Shahrnaz withdraws.

Cut as Arnavaz raises her forearm toward B’s reaching hand.

28mm close handheld medium shot from the room side of Arnavaz, keeping Shahrnaz visible behind her left shoulder.

Continue the raised-arm movement across the cut.

Arnavaz knocks B’s reaching hand aside, plants her feet and drives her free palm against his chest. B absorbs the push and steps forward again. She twists sideways to keep herself between him and her sister, breathing sharply through the effort.

The camera sidesteps with her. The operator’s hurried foot placement creates an uneven lateral shake and a brief tilted horizon, followed by an urgent correction onto the confrontation.

Behind Arnavaz, Shahrnaz rises and retreats two short steps with the cat. As A approaches, she turns her shoulder toward him and curves her upper body around the animal.

The cat squirms once against her forearm. She adjusts her supporting hand beneath it and makes one quick soothing stroke along its back. Its ears remain low.

C crosses the background toward the musician.

Cut on C reaching the musician’s shoulder.

35mm handheld medium shot beside the musician, with the sisters and their approaching guards still visible deeper in the room.

C shoves the musician against the wall and pulls the instrument from his hands. The musician slides into a seated position, reaching after it.

The camera drops slightly with the musician, then snaps its attention upward with the seized instrument.

C drives the instrument’s neck-to-body joint once against the nearby stone doorway edge. The single sharp fracture causes a short involuntary camera jolt. Recover immediately on the damaged instrument as C releases it beside the musician.

At the crack, Shahrnaz jerks around the cat, sheltering it against her chest. Arnavaz flinches but maintains her position between B and her sister, her hands still raised defensively.

End with the broken instrument beside the seated musician and the confrontation continuing in the room.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:

Handheld instability follows the operator’s physical reactions to invasion, obstructing bodies and sudden impacts. Alternate sharp jolts with brief recoveries that clearly reveal the action.

Use close wide-angle perspective, interrupted foregrounds, short motion blur during abrupt reframing and rapid focus recovery.

The sisters remain frightened and active. Shahrnaz’s protective movements are hurried and imperfect. Arnavaz’s resistance is desperate, driven by planted feet, forceful hands and unstable balance.

The cat remains securely supported and visibly unsettled.

LIGHT AND SOUND:

Preserve the room’s warm available daylight and existing furnishings. The open doorway admits colder corridor spill. Passing bodies repeatedly interrupt these sources.

Sound consists of the door impact, rushing boots, startled inhalations, scraping soles, fabric under tension, a brief frightened cat sound, the musician’s expelled breath, one wooden fracture and loose strings rattling against the broken body.

END STATE:

Shahrnaz stands holding the living cat against her chest; A has reached her side. Arnavaz remains upright between her sister and B, ready to resist his next movement. C stands beside the broken instrument. The musician remains alive and seated against the wall. The doorway remains open.

Natural-speed action, tactile materials, analog realism.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
